subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand multimodal memory beyond opt-in image/audio files under `memorySearch.extraPaths` into PDF/video and remembered inbound attachments, and what consent, retention, deletion, provider-upload, and reindex contract must gate it?
rationale: The missing behavior is technically feasible but changes how raw user media is uploaded to remote embedding providers and persisted in searchable memory, so automation cannot choose the boundary safely.

options.title: Design gated media memory first
options.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, retention/deletion behavior, redaction, provider limits, and reindex/migration behavior before implementation work.

options.title: Limit core to shipped subset
options.body: Keep current core behavior at image/audio files under `memorySearch.extraPaths` and close or redirect broader attachment/PDF/video work until stronger maintainer-owned demand appears.

options.title: Expand extraPaths only
options.body: Allow a narrower follow-up for PDF/video files under `extraPaths` while explicitly excluding chat-attachment retention for now.

recommendation.title: Design gated media memory first
recommendation.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, retention/deletion behavior, redaction, provider limits, and reindex/migration behavior before implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision extends the shipped multimodal memory subset and config/docs boundary that gumadeiras introduced.
